title: Test-Time Speculation
abstract: arXiv:2605.09329v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by using a fast draft model to generate tokens and a more accurate target model to verify them. Its performance depends on the $\textit{acceptance length}$, or number of draft tokens accepted by the target. Our studies show that the acceptance length of even state-of-the-art speculators, like DFlash, EAGLE-3, and PARD, degrades with generation length, reaching values close to 1 (i.e., no speedup) within a few thousand output tokens, making speculators ineffective for long-response tasks. Acceptance lengths decline because most speculators are trained offline on short sequences, but are forced to match the target on much longer outputs at inference, well beyond their training distribution.   To address this issue, we propose $\textit{Test-Time Speculation (TTS)}$, an online distillation approach that continuously adapts the speculator at test time. translated_abstract: 推测解码通过使用一个快速的草稿模型来生成token，再由更精确的目标模型进行验证，从而加速大语言模型（LLM）的推理。其性能取决于接受长度，即目标模型所接受的草稿token数量。我们的研究表明，即使是当前最先进的推测器（如DFlash、EAGLE-3和PARD），其接受长度也会随着生成长度的增加而退化，在几千个输出token内降至接近1（即没有加速效果），这使得推测器在长响应任务中失去效力。接受长度下降的原因在于，大多数推测器是在短序列上进行离线训练的，但在推理时却被迫在远超其训练分布的长输出上匹配目标模型。为解决这一问题，我们提出了测试时推测，这是一种在测试阶段持续自适应调整推测器的在线蒸馏方法。TTS利用了一个关键洞察，即…
tldr: 该论文提出测试时推测，通过在线蒸馏在推理阶段持续自适应调整推测器，解决了推测解码因训练与推理序列长度分布不匹配而在长输出任务中接受长度退化、加速失效的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Test-Time Speculation (TTS), an online distillation approach that continuously adapts the speculator at test time, resolving the degradation of acceptance length in speculative decoding for long-generation tasks caused by the mismatch between short-sequence training and long-sequence inference.
